where our strangest
superstitions come from

13 at the table

linked to the last supper.

birthday candles

the smoke was said to carry
your wish to the gods.

the groom can't see the dress

so he couldn't change his mind.

bread upside down in france

once linked to the
executioner's loaf.

touching iron in italy

italians "touch iron",
not wood.

one curious story a day beats
ten minutes of scrolling.
